queue.name: Tiger Pipeline Richland Parish Lateral (Entergy Louisiana, Meta Hyperion supply)
queue.note: New 12-mile Energy Transfer lateral off the Tiger Pipeline, up to 1 Bcf/d, in service February 2028, for Entergy plants serving Meta's Richland Parish data center. Not P5849, which is the operating 2011 Tiger expansion (21, 42 in, 400 MMcf/d), and not the P0265 main line. Expansion row shape: PipelineName 'Tiger Gas Pipeline'. EIA Aug 2026 row 123 names the data center. Vetting should confirm which Entergy plants it feeds (Franklin Farms and the Richland Parish station are both seeds) and the 13.24 mi FERC figure one agent saw but did not verify.

evidence.note: Energy Transfer and Entergy Louisiana 20-year deal. A 12-mile Tiger Pipeline lateral, up to 1 Bcf/d, 250,000 MMBtu/d firm transport from February 2028, delivering to a supply hub at Delhi near new Entergy gas plants that serve Meta's Richland Parish data center.
Rigzone report of the same agreement, naming the 12-mile lateral and the Meta data center.
Entergy press release on the 20-year transport agreement and the Tiger Pipeline lateral extension.
Syndicated copy of the Entergy press release. Same original, not a second source.
News report of the agreement.

queue.name: Texas Eastern Line 31 Expansion Project (Line 31 Loop and Line 14-P Lateral)
queue.note: Texas Eastern expansion with no row of its own: 10.2 mi of 36-inch loop plus a 1.6 mi 16-inch lateral, +125 MMcf/d, 2028, to Entergy Mississippi's Traceview plant. Expansion row shape under 'Texas Eastern Transmission (TETCO) Gas Pipeline'. The data center tie is not yet sourced. If vetting finds no ref tying Traceview or the line to a data center, it is monitor (under 25 km, no data center tie).

evidence.note: FERC scoping notice in the Federal Register. About 10.2 miles of 36-inch loop, a 1.6-mile 16-inch lateral to the Traceview plant, and a new compressor station.
Gas Compression Magazine article. The project serves Entergy Mississippi's planned Traceview Advanced Power Station. No data center customer is named.

matched.name: Mississippi Crossing Project (MSX)
matched.reason: Same Tennessee Gas Pipeline project, Greenville to Butler, about 206 mi, 2.1 Bcf/d. Found only as a data center tag lead. P7841 'Mississippi Crossing Project' carries the same endpoints and specs and looks like a duplicate of P7802. Both PIDs are already on the data center tag worklist. The IEEFA and Mississippi Today sources tie it to utility forecasts and opponents' claims, which by the rules leaves the tag blank.

evidence.note: Mississippi Today on the FERC-approved project and the challenge to it.
IEEFA analysis tying MSX and SSE4 to utility data center forecasts.
